spans.s:
A द्वन्द compound of words denoting (persons who have studied) subjects, which in their order of study are not remote from each other, is singular.

Terms: समास-द्वन्द

And the words 1. अध्याय 2. न्याय 3. उद्याव 4. संहार 5. आधारा 6. आवयाः are anomalous.

Terms: Irregular

The affix ठञ् comes after the name of an explainable work called after a ऋषि in the senses of 'occurring therein' or 'commentary thereon' when it referes to an अध्याय only.

Terms: ठञ्

The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'who studies there' after a word in the Locative -7th case in construction, denoting an improper place or time.

Terms: ठक्
The affix having the senses taught up to

, is elided by लुक् after a stem beginning with the word अध्यर्ध , and after a द्विगु compound, when it is not in a name.

Terms:
When an अध्याय or अनुवाक is to be expressed there is लुक् elision of the affix छ (ईय) having the sense of मतुप् -- तदस्यास्त्यस्मिन्निति मतुप्‌
